import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_medicare_enrollment.xlsx', sheet_name='Enrollment', header=None)
# Row 2 contains header (index 1), data starts row 3 (index 2)
df.columns = [str(c).replace('\n', ' ').strip() for c in df.iloc[1]]
df = df.iloc[2:].reset_index(drop=True)
df['Calendar Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Calendar Year'])
df['Total'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Total'])
result = float(df.loc[df['Calendar Year'] == 2023, 'Total'].iloc[0])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_medicare_enrollment.xlsx', sheet_name='Enrollment', header=None)
df.columns = [str(c).replace('\n', ' ').strip() for c in df.iloc[1]]
